record.body: Signature dialects are designed local variants of a shared Signature song: each district of the fictional range sings a measurably different version, defined by its syllable order and pitch contour, and young singers copy their local adults, so the variants persist. The design includes a dialect map rule, stating how many districts exist and how many singers each holds, so the total population can be computed and the spread of a new variant simulated. These are Signature inventions, not data from any real population. This record covers the Signature biophony layer, distinct from Signature geophony and Signature anthrophony.
